releaseNotes: Improved LG TV discovery when the advertised description port changes, with bounded retries and better scan failure handling. Added automatic private local diagnostics for connection failures and unexpected app errors. Tap Diagnostics on a connection error, or Settings → Connection diagnostics, then Copy report or Share report. Reports omit pairing keys, typed text, private TV addresses and raw error messages. Reports are shared only when you choose; there is no automatic upload. Existing themes and TV controls are retained.
